purpose: Independent mathematical handoff candidates for WP05 likelihood primitives and WP06 posterior-summary verification; no runtime implementation or inference algorithm selection.

source.hash_encoding: Exact bytes decoded from GitHub base64 contents response, with no newline or encoding transformation.
source.upstream_reference: Source test attributes its oracle to R 4.4.3 pnorm(log.p=TRUE); R was not executed for this candidate calculation.

normal_interval_log_probabilities.mathematical_basis: P(a < Z <= b) = integral_a^b exp(-x^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi) dx. A continuous Normal law gives the same probability for any inclusion choice at the finite endpoints.
normal_interval_log_probabilities.independent_calculation: P=(b-a)*quad_t[0,1] exp(-(a+(b-a)*t)^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi); log_probability=ln(P), with mpmath at 100 decimal digits. This integrates density directly and never subtracts CDF or survival probabilities.
normal_interval_log_probabilities.input_precision_note: The independent calculation interprets input decimal strings exactly. The C# 1E-20 literal is rounded to binary64; the retained 2e-13 log-probability tolerance safely covers this input-rounding difference.
normal_interval_log_probabilities.scope_limit: Validates Normal interval probability and numerical stability. Does not specify historical-count combinatorics, record pairing, rating uncertainty, Flike likelihood conventions or other family kernels.

normal_known_variance_conjugate_posterio.data_provenance: Newly specified deterministic synthetic observations [1,2,3]. No observations, random seed sequence, expected numerical values or Monte Carlo tolerance copied from the RMC C# test.

model.sampling_assumption: Conditionally independent y_i given mu, each Normal(mu, sigma=2).

methodology_reference.hash_encoding: Exact bytes decoded from GitHub base64 contents response, with no newline or encoding transformation.
methodology_reference.role: Methodological example: compare posterior mean, SD and central interval with the conjugate solution. Its N=1000 seeded sample, prior, numerical results and stochastic assertion tolerances are not reused.

mathematical_basis.derivation: Complete the square in the product of the Normal prior density and n Normal likelihood densities for mu.

normal_known_variance_conjugate_posterio.tolerance_policy: Deterministic expected quantities are recorded at high precision. No stochastic pass/fail tolerance is prescribed; the WP06 owner must choose diagnostics and uncertainty-aware acceptance criteria for the implemented sampler.
scope_limits: Posterior for the mean parameter mu, not a posterior predictive interval for a new observation.
Analytic benchmark does not select or implement MCMC; the legacy production importance-sampling requirement remains unchanged.
Does not establish legacy Flike prior coordinates, supplied-prior behavior, distribution-family inference or output-estimand compatibility.
